en.title: Score Correction and Audit Logs
en.excerpt: Official procedures for correcting recorded arrow scores with judge authorization and reviewing audit trails.

toc.text: Editing Previous Ends in the Tablet

en.content:
World Archery Correction Protocols

Once arrows are drawn from the target butt, values cannot be altered without the explicit authorization of an official line judge. If a transcription error occurs, scorekeepers must follow standard correction procedures.

Editing Previous Ends in the Tablet

To modify an existing score:

  1. On the scoring screen, tap the end summary card (e.g., End 3).
  2. Tap the specific arrow box that requires correction.
  3. Select the revised arrow value from the keypad.
  4. Tap Submit Correction.

Judge Authorization Requirement

When an existing end is modified, the interface prompts the scorekeeper to enter the assigned Judge PIN or check the verbal referee authorization box.

Server-Side Audit Trails

Every score modification creates an immutable audit log entry recording the previous value, new value, timestamp, scorekeeper ID, and device IP address to maintain total competition integrity.
